title: Evaluated policies
purpose: LLM agents and served VLAs that drive embodiments through the policy contract.

requirements.title: LLM-agent policy (GPT-6-astra)
requirements.why: The frontier agent writes control code per turn against the bridge API

acceptance.text: Each turn the model receives the scene frame, the egocentric head-camera frame, and the previous measured receipt, and emits one program(code) call
program() code runs in a no-imports sandbox limited to the bridge API, np, math, and print, inside a sim-step budget

requirements.title: GR00T N as a served VLA policy
requirements.why: An open-weights VLA is the first low-level policy under the LLM supervisor

acceptance.text: The gr00t policy adapter downloads released Isaac GR00T N weights from Hugging Face into the local HF cache (not git), loads them, and emits joint_pos action chunks on the G1 contract

requirements.title: Layered supervisor control
requirements.why: The LLM sets subgoals; the VLA or controllers execute them at control rate

acceptance.text: The supervisor's turn output names a subgoal (target object, destination, or walk command) that the low-level layer executes
Transcript records both the supervisor turn and the low-level chunk count it spawned

requirements.title: Persistent experience store
requirements.why: Trials carry forward lessons and self-authored skills, nothing else

acceptance.text: After each episode the model's reflections write lessons to memory.md and reusable defs to learned_skills.json, injected into the next prompt
Each trial starts a fresh conversation; only memory.md, learned_skills.json, and workspace/ persist

requirements.title: G1 bowl-touch demonstrations recorded for GR00T N post-training
requirements.why: Released GR00T N has no action head for this G1 or kitchen, so the bowl touch comes from post-training on G1 demonstrations, never from a scripted reach at eval time

acceptance.text: demos.py records at least 200 G1 episodes in LeRobot format (head-camera frames, joint state, 50 Hz joint_pos actions) from randomized starts, each ending in a measured palm-bowl contact

requirements.title: GR00T N action head post-trained on the G1 demonstrations
requirements.why: Released GR00T N has no action head for this G1 or kitchen; post-training on recorded G1 demonstrations supplies one without a scripted reach at eval time

acceptance.text: finetune.py post-trains the released GR00T N checkpoint on the POL-5 episodes on one 8 GB GPU with the vision-language backbone frozen, writing the checkpoint outside git

requirements.title: Post-trained GR00T N touches the bowl from a held-out start
requirements.why: The bowl touch must come from the post-trained policy's own joint actions, never from a scripted reach at eval time

acceptance.text: With only the post-trained checkpoint's joint_pos chunks driving the G1 at 50 Hz and no scripted reach in the loop, a held-out start ends in a measured palm-bowl contact
